title: Minimal Luxury FAQ
description: An ultra-clean monochrome product FAQ featuring generous whitespace, fine hairline dividers, and delicate height expansion animation.
heading: Essential Product FAQ
subtitle: Clear, standardized guidance on materials, sizing, and garment care.

questions.question: What certified thread count is woven into the outer cotton shell?
questions.answer: Our outerwear shell utilizes a high-density 400TC long-staple organic Egyptian cotton, delivering a windproof weave while maintaining breathability.

questions.question: Are the closures and hardware rust-resistant?
questions.answer: All zippers and snap buttons are custom-forged from solid brass with a matte PVD electroplated finish, guaranteed against oxidation and tarnishing.

questions.question: What temperature environment is this outerwear rated for?
questions.answer: Comfort-rated for temperatures between -5°C to 15°C (23°F to 59°F) when layered with lightweight knits.
